relationship_to_A: Inference addendum; A main fits remain 45, first phase 30, new B fits 0.

frozen_deployed_system.estimand: Utility of the available complete system on a fixed user task.
frozen_deployed_system.training_data: Native training retained, provenance and exposure disclosed.
frozen_deployed_system.inputs: Native preprocessing from the same allowed information. No test-pair experimental complex in the sequence/SMILES discovery task.
frozen_deployed_system.claim_limit: Not an architecture causal contrast; unknown training overlap precludes unqualified unseen-pair generalization.

validation_adapted_system.estimand: Utility after prespecified local validation calibration or fusion.
validation_adapted_system.FPR_threshold: Threshold selected on validation at >=90% positive recall; disclose validation exposure and achieved test recall.

A_controlled_training.claim_limit: Attribution only to controlled changed factors. Native DrugBAN changes inputs and architecture.

training_exposure.excluded_requires: Complete checkpoint-specific supervised and selection members plus successful identity mapping. Incomplete membership or unmapped identities remain UNKNOWN.
training_exposure.encoder_pretraining: Separate unsupervised entity exposure from pair supervision and complex information.
training_exposure.common_unseen: Use identical audited-excluded members for the reported contrast. Model-specific excluded subsets are not comparable leaderboards.
training_exposure.existing_141: Unseen only relative to local A/B train+validation, not all public weights.
training_exposure.date_rule: Database release date is not experiment publication date.

evaluation_views: All fixed requests: applicability, coverage, failure, abstention and cost.
All-model common coverage: matched identities and candidates, N and query counts.
Pairwise common coverage: independent explicit denominators; not a transitive global leaderboard.
Measured labels on identical members: endpoint-stratified correctness.
Audited common-unseen relations if qualified; otherwise no clean-generalization champion.
unsupported_policy: Keep UNSUPPORTED, IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED, INPUT_MISSING, TRUNCATED, RUNTIME_ERROR, NOT_YET_COMPUTED, AUTHOR_WARNING, ABSTAINED separate; never impute zero or negative.
ranking: Both query directions, average ranks and tie-aware TopK; counts and missingness included. Unknown pairs have no truth labels.
budget: Report native default cost and any prespecified common resource-cap sensitivity separately. At K=10 report filled slots, confirmed positives and unmeasured slots separately; no silent fallback.
endpoints: Kd, Ki, IC50 and functional evidence separated. Nesso binder versus IC50 head and DTBind occurrence versus complex-affinity are distinct.
statistics: Paired query comparisons; scaffold/target homology cluster uncertainty; both overall and query counts. Low rank correlation is not evidence of error.
publication: Deployment observations plus A controlled explanation; never substitute public-system differences for architecture causality.
